title: Balance: receipts and expenses have direction
goal: Write two own recorder sets and verify 20, time boundaries and dimension isolation.

prerequisites.text: Complete P1–P5. Distinguish a common-module function from its application caller; preserve your source and run a separate training infobase.

sections.title: The question we are checking
paragraphs: The register contains a 30-minute receipt and 10-minute expense. Simply adding 40 does not answer “how much remains”. Follow movement direction, time, and customer.
Use a new training copy and invented records only. Predict first, then compare the observation; preserve existing functions, files, and records.

sections.title: Dimensions say where; resources say how much
paragraphs: For service obligations, customer is a dimension and minutes a resource. Receipt 30 increases obligation; expense 10 reduces it. Sign follows business meaning, not whether an event is good or bad. Balance 20 derives from movements; manually maintaining it in a card too creates two sources of truth.

Add balance accumulation register Обязательства with Клиент: CatalogRef.Клиенты dimension and Минуты: Number(15,2) resource, selected among ЗаявкаУслуги movements. Keep Трудозатраты as turnover-kind; do not change an existing populated register’s kind.

sections.title: Add only the missing part of your own setup
paragraphs: Retain P5 work and its DT. Use a new separately restored copy; preserve older fields/functions and do not reload a full CF over custom work.
Accumulation registers → Обязательства, Balances; Клиент: CatalogRef.Клиенты; Минуты: Number 15, 2. Select it under ЗаявкаУслуги movements. Retain old fields/Трудозатраты.

Preserve the УчебныеДанные common module. Each experience shows its complete preparation. If НовыйНаборРегистров already exists, do not add another definition:retain it and append only the new function. Do not load a full CF over your work.

sections.title: The application call and its observation
paragraphs: Two movement sets belong to separate own documents. A receipt of 30 increases the obligation, and an expense of 10 reduces it:the balance is 20. Before the movement date there are no rows. Another customer does not inherit those 20.
Each message is labelled: identical Да values concern different assertions. Find the expression behind each line and distinguish its truth from the fact that the program ran.

sections.title: Recorders explain origin
paragraphs: Each movement links to a document, explaining the balance. Movement period and document date can have distinct meanings under configuration rules. A total screenshot without drill-down is insufficient. Preserve recorder identity and compare recorder-filtered sets when reposting.

Preparation creates an own customer/service and 30/10 documents. The function writes receipt 30 and expense 10 using their recorder filters. A positive expense value with Expense direction reduces balance; do not also negate it without a different explicit contract.

sections.title: Your prediction first
paragraphs: An expense of 25 is replaced with 15 for the same recorder, with a receipt of 90. What balance follows?
Identify the changed action and what should remain unchanged. Reveal the explanation after making your own prediction.

reveal.title: Check the reasoning
paragraphs: 75. Записать(Истина) replaces the set selected by the recorder filter. The old 25 must not remain alongside the new 15. Other recorders are retained.

sections.title: Balance depends on time
paragraphs: After receipt 30 atD1, balance is 30; after expense 10 atD2, it is 20. Specify boundary inclusion and time precision. Period turnover and point-in-time balance are different quantities. Before the first movement, expect the agreed zero rather than a stale report result.

Expect 20 on Nov 3, no earlier rows on Nov 1 and none for another own customer. These independently test arithmetic, time and dimensions. Do not compare against the whole infobase total. References and recorders trace every movement.

sections.title: Trace preservation step by step
paragraphs: The first three nodes explain directional change of one balance. The last is a separate dimension-isolation check, not deletion of that balance.
Read each arrow: what value or relation exists now, and which action changes it? The diagram explains the selected property rather than replacing the source.

sections.title: An error that can look successful
paragraphs: Choosing Приход for both rows preserves their amounts and customer but gives 40 instead of 20. Check movement direction separately from resource magnitude.
Keep the faulty copy separate. To establish a fix, compare the relevant observation with your prior expectation; do not change an expectation merely to obtain a match.

sections.title: An invariant detects duplicate writes
paragraphs: Opening + receipts − expenses = closing. Verify independently, then repost the receipt. A duplicated 30 must not turn 20 into 50. Add another customer and check dimension isolation. Prohibiting negative balance needs an explicit business rule and reliable concurrent checking inP10.

Expense 11 is a compilable negative control yielding 19 rather than 20. Write(True) replaces the filtered recorder set; an incorrect/missing filter is dangerous. The code clears no entire register or earlier documents. Record created identities and work only in your copy.

sections.title: Now a new independent task
paragraphs: For a new own customer create receipt 90 and expense 25:balance 65. Replace only that expense recorder’s set with 15:balance 75. Verify another customer without movements has no rows.
The worked example addresses another question. Begin with this task’s starter and reveal the reference after your attempt. Viewing an example or reference does not replace your code.

paragraphs: УчебныеДанные common module: Server and Server call enabled; Client, Global, and Privileged disabled. Functions are outside procedures. The application module has one handler that calls the function and displays labelled result fields.

Preserve the previous handler separately. Run the experiment once in your copy, compare labelled messages and specific new records, then remove only the added startup call. Do not delete records to match a screenshot.
